p|panel|cert_no_firma: It carries no authority's signature: it is a SHA-256 seal and a reference into the record's own chain. Whoever holds this computer could rebuild the whole record; what they cannot do is change a row without the chain saying so.
p|panel|cert_imprimir: To keep it as a PDF: Print › Save as PDF.
p|panel|der_lead: The companies this computer contacted in the certificate's period. For each one, the letter asking what data it holds about you, or that it delete it, under the law of your country, addressed to its privacy channel and with the extract of the certificate that concerns it. You review it and send it from your own email.
p|panel|der_vacio: In this period this computer contacted no known company.
p|panel|der_nunca_envia: GUARDIANA sends nothing on its own: the letter opens in your email or is copied for the company's form, and you attach the extract yourself.
p|panel|der_cobertura_parcial: The record does not cover the whole period.
p|panel|der_solo_cortadas: These companies only received queries GUARDIANA blocked, so no letter tells them this computer contacted them: {empresas}.
p|panel|der_canal_ninguno: not checked by us; use the one its website gives.
p|panel|der_para_formulario: its privacy form (the letter is copied for you to paste)
p|panel|der_adjunta: Attach the certificate extract (.html or .json); the letter already carries its seal.
p|panel|der_carta_evidencia:
This computer, mine, contacted your services on these dates, according to the chained record GUARDIANA keeps on it (it records which internet names the computer asks for, never the content):
{lineas}
In total, {veces} answered, over {dias}.
This does not prove that you hold personal data about me, nor that any was sent to you: it only identifies which of your services my computer contacted and when. I attach the certificate extract; its SHA-256 seal is {sello}.
p|panel|borrado_jur_otro: Another country · a law GUARDIANA has not checked
p|panel|borrado_ley_otro: no law GUARDIANA has checked for my country
p|panel|borrado_articulo_otro: the law of my country may not oblige you to delete personal data
p|panel|borrado_articulo_acceso_otro: the law of my country may not oblige you to tell me what data you hold about me
p|panel|borrado_nota_otro: GUARDIANA has not checked the law of your country, so the letter is a request, not a legal demand: many companies answer such requests under their own policy. If the company is in the European Union, the United Kingdom or California, its law may protect you as well; if so, choose that place.
p|panel|borrado_queja_otro: GUARDIANA does not know your country's authority. Look for whether your country has a data protection authority; if the company has its seat in the European Union, you can also write to the authority of that country.
p|panel|borrado_autoridad_otro: your country's, if it has one
p|panel|hx_ap_estado_on: Blocked: everything but the essentials and what you allow
p|panel|hx_intro: Three things done here, on this computer. No file leaves it: GUARDIANA looks at it and does not keep it.
p|panel|hx_error: It could not be done. Try again.
p|panel|hx_ap_que: Blocks everything this computer asks the internet for, except what the system needs to stay healthy (Windows updates, the time, certificates, GUARDIANA) and what you let through, one by one. The same button turns it off and everything is as before. The panel keeps working: it lives on this computer.
p|panel|hx_ap_confirmar: Programs not on the list will stop connecting until you turn it off or let them through. Calls and messages too. Turn it on?
p|panel|hx_ap_cortados: What it blocked in the last hour
p|panel|hx_ap_cortados_nota: This computer only. If something you need stopped working, let it through here.
p|panel|hx_ap_esenciales_nota: Each name also lets through what hangs from it. The list is short on purpose: every line is an open door.
p|panel|hx_ap_desde: On since {fecha}. It is written in the extract, with every name it blocks.
p|panel|hx_ap_apagado_nada: With the blackout off, nothing is blocked by it.
p|panel|hx_ap_no_nombre: That is not an internet name (or the list already has 200).
p|panel|hx_para_red_local: Your home network (does not reach the internet)
p|panel|hx_li_que: A photo can say where it was taken, with which phone and when; a document, who wrote it and at which company. GUARDIANA reads only those header data, never the picture or the text, and gives you a copy without them. The original is not touched.
p|panel|hx_li_zona: Drop a photo or a document here, or click to choose it
p|panel|hx_li_grande: This file is over 64 MB: GUARDIANA does not look at it.
p|panel|hx_li_otro: Not a format GUARDIANA can read: JPEG, PNG and HEIC photos; PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents.
p|panel|hx_li_limpio: Its headers say nothing about you.
p|panel|hx_li_original: The copy has the same name with «-sin-huellas». You can save it next to the original.
p|panel|hx_h_plantilla: Template in a folder of your computer
p|panel|hx_nota_pdf_comprimido: This PDF keeps part of its structure compressed, where GUARDIANA does not look: it may carry data not shown here.
p|panel|hx_nota_heic_no_seguido: This HEIC photo keeps its data in a way GUARDIANA does not follow: cleaning is not offered rather than leaving it half done.
p|panel|hx_in_que: Windows checks its digital signature here: whether it has one, who put it there, whether the file is still what was signed and whether the chain reaches an authority this computer trusts. The file is not uploaded anywhere and the copy is deleted when done.
p|panel|hx_in_zona: Drop the installer here (.exe, .msi), or click to choose it
p|panel|hx_in_aviso: A signature says who published it and that nobody changed it since. It does not say it is safe: harmful programs have shipped with valid signatures.
p|panel|hx_in_sin_sello: no timestamp: the signature stops counting when the certificate expires
p|panel|hx_in_cadena: The certificate chain reaches an authority this Windows trusts, and the file is exactly what was signed.
p|panel|hx_in_sin_firma_texto: Nobody signed this file: there is no way to know who published it or whether someone changed it on the way.
p|panel|hx_in_no_valida_texto: It has a signature, but it does not hold: the file changed after signing, or the certificate is not trusted or was revoked. The name it claims is not repeated here, because it is not proven.
p|panel|hx_in_no_admitido: This kind of file does not carry an Authenticode signature: Windows cannot say who signed it.
p|panel|hx_in_no_disponible: Windows does this check, and it is only available on Windows.
p|panel|qsr_desde: What this computer used since {fecha} (there is no detail from before).
p|panel|qsr_siete_dias: What this computer used in the last 7 days.
p|panel|qsr_resumen_sin_programa: This computer used it, but Windows did not say which program.
p|panel|qsr_resumen_nada: No program on this computer used it in the window measured.
p|panel|qsr_resumen: It may stop working in {n} programs: {programas}.
p|panel|qsr_resumen_uno: It may stop working in 1 program: {programas}.
p|panel|qsr_nada: No program on this computer and no other device of the house used it.
p|panel|qsr_puede_parar: This may stop working if you block it:
p|panel|qsr_sin_programa: And {n} more times from this computer without Windows saying which program.
p|panel|qsr_sin_programa_uno: And once more from this computer without Windows saying which program.
p|panel|qsr_otros: Other devices of the house asked for it {n} times (which program, only this computer says).
p|panel|qsr_otros_uno: Another device of the house asked for it once (which program, only this computer says).
p|panel|qsr_limite: It counts what was seen, no more: a program that did not ask in this time, or uses its own DNS, does not appear.
p|panel|pie: GUARDIANA runs entirely on this computer. There is no account and no server of ours, and the only thing it sends without you asking is the license check with the payment gateway, recorded in “What GUARDIANA knows about you”.
p|panel|sin_sesion_texto: Open the panel from the GUARDIANA launcher (or from the guardiana observe window), which includes the session key. The key lives in this tab, is deleted when you close it and is not stored as a cookie.
p|panel|radiografia_lead: Which services this computer is trying to talk to right now, with their category and one sentence per signal. Real figures from the ledger, no rounding.
p|panel|radiografia_limite: GUARDIANA sees service names and, on Windows, when the system says so, which program on this computer asked for them; never what content was sent. It never says “malicious”: it says what it observed.
p|panel|trampa_frase: This name only exists inside one of your trap files. GUARDIANA did not open that file or any other: all it saw is that something asked for this name, and that name cannot be known without having read the file.
p|panel|ia_programa_titulo: The program that made those queries, according to Windows itself. Only on this computer: from a phone in Home Mode you see the service name and nothing else.
p|panel|sin_consultas_aun: No queries yet. Browse a little and they will show up here.
p|panel|extracto_lead: Every query on record, with who decided what. Filter, export and verify the chain.
p|panel|mostrando_ocultos: Another {n} belong to devices that do not share their detail with the home panel: they are counted, not shown.
p|panel|mostrando_ocultos_uno: One more belongs to a device that does not share its detail with the home panel: it is counted, not shown.
p|panel|reglas_ocultas: There are {n} more rules that devices set for themselves and that do not share their detail: they are counted, not shown.
p|panel|reglas_ocultas_uno: There is 1 more rule that a device set for itself and that does not share its detail: it is counted, not shown.
p|panel|mi_por_ip: This device is known by its address on the network, not by its hardware address (MAC). If the router gives this address to another device, that one will see this history from here and inherit this checkbox as it is.
p|panel|cadena_lead: Every entry carries the hash of the previous one. If someone deleted or changed a line, it shows here.
p|panel|cadena_ok_recortada: Chain verified: {n} events correct; {p} earlier ones already summarized by retention.
p|panel|cadena_rota: The chain is broken at event {id}: {motivo}.
p|panel|dispositivos_lead: Totals per device. A device’s detail is visible only from that device, unless its owner shares it.
p|panel|dispositivos_limite: Until Home Mode is on, only this PC appears here. In Home Mode, GUARDIANA sees service names, not which app asked for them.
p|panel|sabe_lead: Everything this program stores, where it stores it, and everything it has sent out of this computer.
p|panel|s_no_respuestas: Only queries are recorded: name, type, device, time, category and verdict; on Windows, for this computer’s own and when the system says so, also which program asked: its name, its path on disk (which may include your user name) and the file’s hash. Answers are never stored; only the country and network of the server that answered, to tell you where your data travels, and, when a name answers as another company’s tracker, the name of that tracker’s site. Never the content.
p|panel|retencion_ilimitada: no limit: nothing is deleted, not even when you stop paying
p|panel|outbound_lead: Every connection the program made by itself: activating the license and the subscription check (8 days after activating it and once per period). There is no other: the lists ship inside the program and new versions are installed by you. With whom, when and how many bytes.
p|panel|outbound_vacio: GUARDIANA has sent nothing out of this computer.
p|panel|maxima_explica: In one click, GUARDIANA blocks across the home the names the open lists know as trackers, advertising or telemetry: on this computer and on the devices that use GUARDIANA, not only in the browser. It never touches what a device needs to work (updates, time, messaging, calls), it starts on each device once GUARDIANA has watched it for 24 hours, and any name can be allowed from its row.
p|panel|maxima_limite: GUARDIANA blocks by name: when a company’s tracking uses the same name as its website, it cannot separate the two without breaking that website. GUARDIANA ZERO blocks that, because it sees the whole address.
p|panel|maxima_espera: It does not block anything yet: GUARDIANA has been watching this home for less than 24 hours.

p|panel|qv_prog_titulo: Programs that talk to a data buyer or seller
p|panel|qv_pedir_borrado: Ask it to delete your data
p|panel|qv_prog_vacio: No program on this computer talked to a registered data broker or to a company in a documented case.
